name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position: it wants the European Union to push for a strong global role in governing artificial intelligence, and it backs the United Nations work on this, including a new independent scientific panel and a global dialogue on AI governance. It also asks the European Commission, the Council and the EU's foreign policy chief to support worldwide efforts to govern AI in line with human rights, and to keep the EU's approach coordinated.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament only states its support and makes a request.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, the Council and the EU foreign policy chief, who are asked to act.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to them, to member states, the Council of Europe and the UN Secretary-General.
